mapper.sql: select id, order_no, user_id, course_id, name, gender, phone, company, accommodation, enrollment_id, amount, status, wechat_transaction_id, refund_no, pay_time, sign_time, refund_time, request_id, create_time, update_time from course_pay_order
mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc, id desc
where user_id = #{userId} and course_id = #{courseId} and status in (1, 2) order by pay_time desc, id desc limit 1
where user_id = #{userId} and course_id = #{courseId} and status = 0 order by create_time desc, id desc limit 1
where course_id = #{courseId} and user_id = #{userId} and status in (1, 2, 3) order by create_time desc, id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into course_pay_order (order_no, user_id, course_id, name, gender, phone, company, accommodation, enrollment_id, amount, status, wechat_transaction_id, refund_no, pay_time, sign_time, refund_time, request_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{courseId}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{company}, #{accommodation}, #{enrollmentId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{wechatTransactionId}, #{refundNo}, #{payTime}, #{signTime}, #{refundTime}, #{requestId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select:
select cpo.id as order_id, cpo.order_no, cpo.user_id, cpo.course_id, l.name as course_name, case when cpo.name is not null and cpo.name != '' then cpo.name when ui.real_name is not null and ui.real_name != '' then ui.real_name when ui.user_name is not null and ui.user_name != '' then ui.user_name else '未注册用户' end as user_name, cpo.amount, cpo.status, case when cpo.status = 2 then true else false end as signed_in, case when cpo.status = 2 then true else false end as can_refund, cpo.sign_time, cpo.refund_time from course_pay_order cpo left join lectures l on l.id = cpo.course_id left join user_info ui on ui.user_id = cpo.user_id where cpo.status in (2, 3)
and cpo.course_id = #{courseId}
and (cpo.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cpo.phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cpo.order_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ui.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by cpo.sign_time desc, cpo.id desc
